data.titulo: Ukubukwa eBhabhiloni kuya ekuphakulweni kudoti lJerusalemu
data.contenido:
Yizilayɛma ne yiale bɛ diedi ne anwo sɔnea dɔɔnwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle Babelɔn la. Bɛvuandinle Hyeedelake, Mihyake nee Abɛdenɛgo bɛguale sendɔlɔra nu, noko Nyamenle yele bɛ vindele mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ nye gyi zo a. Nzinlii, mɔɔ Midiama nee Pɛhyeama honle vale Babelɔn wiele la, bɛvale Daneɛle bɛdole awenade tunli nu, noko Nyamenle eza bɔle ɔ nwo bane ɔlua awenade ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔtotole bɛ nloa anu la azo.

Awieleɛ kolaa ne, Saelɛse, Pɛhyea belemgbunli ne manle Yizilayɛma nyianle bɛ ti. Bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle Babelɔn la, ye ɛvolɛ 70 anzi ala a bɛziale bɛrale bɛ maanle nu a. Ninyɛne mɔɔ lumua mɔɔ bɛyɛle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛziale bɛrale Gyɛlusalɛm la anu ko a le kɛ bɛbɔle Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne ɛzilɛ bo. Noko akee, yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ agbɔvolɛ manle bɛgyakyile bɛ gyima ne a. Yemɔti bɛziale bɛrale Gyɛlusalɛm la ye ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ 22 anzi yɛɛ akee bɛwiele ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne si a.

Mɔɔ doa ye la, yɛsukoa adenle mɔɔ Ɛzela dule ziale rale Gyɛlusalɛm razieziele ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne la anwo debie. Bɛzile ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne bɛwiele la ye ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ 47 anzi a ɔyɛle ɛhye a. Akee wɔ Ɛzela adendulɛ ne anzi ɛvolɛ 13, Nihɛmaya boale manle bɛkyekyele Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛgologolo ɛgua la. Foa NNU ne ka ɛvolɛ 152 anwo tetedwɛkɛ toonwo mɔɔ ba yɛ mekɛ ye azo.

ASOO ɛkakye kɛ wɔde mgbavolɛ nsa ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ ɛlɛ ɔ? Ɛhɛe, bɛmɛ a le Daneɛle agɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ kpole kɛ bɛkɛli aleɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔnle kpalɛ ɔmmaa bɛ la. Babelɔnma vɛlɛle bɛ Hyeedelake, Mihyake yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo. Na akee nea bɛ. Duzu ati a bɛmbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmmaa ananze totohyia ɛhye kɛmɔ awie biala ɛlɛyɛ la ɛ? Maa yɛnlea ɛ.

Asoo ɛkakye mɛla ne mɔɔ Gyihova mumua ne hɛlɛle mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Mɛla Bulu ne la ɔ? Mɔɔ lumua la se: ‘Mmasonle nyamenle gyɛne biala kɛ me ngome ala.’ Mgbavolɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la ɛlɛdi mɛla ɛhye azo, ɔnvane nwolɛ kɛ ye ɛyɛlɛ yɛ se la.

Babelɔn belemgbunli, Nɛbukadenɛza, ɛdo ɛsalɛ ɛvɛlɛ menli mɔɔ lɛ dibelɛ mgbole la dɔɔnwo kɛ bɛrazonle ananze ɛhye mɔɔ yezie la. Kɛ ɔhanle ɔhilele menli ne amuala la ɛne: ‘Saa bɛte kɛ bɛlɛbɔ aweɛne ne mɔ, getaa ngakyile yɛɛ gyɛne biala a, awie biala ɛbɔ ɔ ti aze ɛzonle ezukoa nvutuke ananze ɛhye. Awie biala mɔɔ ambɔ ɔ ti aze anzonle la, bɛbavuandi ye bɛado sendɔlɔra nu bɛayela ye ɛkɛ ne ala.’

Mɔɔ Nɛbukadenɛza dele kɛ Hyeedelake, Mihyake nee Abɛdenɛgo ambɔ bɛ ti aze la, ye ahonle futule kpole. Ɔmanle bɛvɛlɛle bɛ bɛrale. Ɔmanle bɛ adenle bieko kɛ bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze. Noko mgbavolɛ ne mɔ vale bɛ nwo dole Gyihova anwo zo. Bɛbuale Nɛbukadenɛza kɛ: ‘Yɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yɛsonle ye la kola die yɛ. Na saa yeanlie yɛ bɔbɔ a yɛnrɛbɔ yɛ ti aze yɛnrɛmaa wɔ ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne.’

Nɛbukadenɛza dele ɛhye la, ɔvale ɛya kpole kpalɛ. Ɛnee sendɔlɔra bie bikye ɛkɛ ne ala na ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Bɛhua sendɔlɔra ne bɛmaa ye ɛzɔlɛ ɛyɛ kpole ɛdɛla dɛba ɛdeɛ ne mɔ fane nsuu!’ Akee ɔmanle menli kekahilii mɔɔ wɔ ye ɛlɔnema ne anu la kyekyele Hyeedelake, Mihyake nee Abɛdenɛgo na bɛvuandinle bɛ bɛguale sendɔlɔra ne anu. Sendɔlɔra ne le kpole la ati ɔyelale mrenya kekahilii ne mɔ ɔhunle bɛ. Na boni a dole mgbavolɛ nsa ne mɔɔ bɛvuandinle bɛ bɛguale nuhua la ɛ?

Belemgbunli ne nleanle sendɔlɔra ne anu, na ye ahonle dule kpole. Ɔbizale kɛ: ‘Ayi mɔ, na tɛ menli nsa a yɛkyekyele bɛ yɛvuandinle bɛ yɛguale senle ne anu a?’

Ye sonvolɛma ne buale kɛ: ‘Ɔle nɔhalɛ.’

Ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Noko menwu menli nna kɛ bɛluolua senle ne anu. Bɛtɛkyekyele bɛ, yɛɛ senle ne ɛnyela bɛ. Na mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la zɔho bozonle.’ Belemgbunli ne bikyele sendɔlɔra ne na ɔdeanle nu kɛ: ‘Hyeedelake! Mihyake! Abɛdenɛgo! Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne sonvolɛma, bɛvinde bɛrɛla!’

Mɔɔ bɛvindele bɛrale la, awie biala nwunle ye kɛ bɛ nwo ɛleka biala ambu ɛbonle. Akee belemgbunli ne hanle kɛ: ‘Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Hyeedelake, Mihyake yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo Nyamenle ne! Yezoa ye anwumabɔvolɛ yemaa yeralie bɛ ɔluakɛ bɛdule bɛ gye kɛ bɛnrɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛnrɛzonle nyamenle biala kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ne ala.’

Asoo ɛhye ɛnle nɔhalɛ mɔɔ yɛdi yɛamaa Gyihova la anwo neazo kɛnlɛma mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdi ɔ nzi a?Adendulɛ 20:⁠3; Daneɛle 3:1-30. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Ɛsalɛ Bie Kɛlɛ Bane Ne Anwo
data.contenido:
DUZU a ɛlɛsi ɛke a? Menli ne mɔ ɛlɛto ɛkponle kpole bie. Babelɔnma belemgbunli ne ɛdo ɛsalɛ ɛvɛlɛ menli mɔɔ le titile la apenle ko. Bɛlɛfa ezukoa nvutuke ahɔpo ne nee dwɛtɛ fufule ahɔpo ne yɛɛ ahyɛnze ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsesale bɛvile Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la a bɛado ɛkponle ne a. Noko, arɛlevilɛ nu ala, sonla sa ɛlɛsɛka vindele na ɔhɛlɛle bane ne anwo. Ɛzulolɛ hanle awie biala.

Nɛbukadenɛza alɔnra Bɛlehyaza a ɛnee le belemgbunli a. Ɔdeanle nuhua kɛ bɛvɛlɛ ye nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne mɔ bɛmaa bɛrɛla. Belemgbunli ne hanle kɛ: ‘Awie biala mɔɔ kɛhola kɛgenga ngɛlɛlera ɛhye na ɔkɛhile me ɔ bo la, banyia ahyɛlɛdeɛ dɔɔnwo na yeayɛ tumivolɛ kpole mɔɔ anwo hyia mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anu a.’ Noko nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne anu biala angola ngɛlɛlera ne mɔɔ wɔ bane ne anwo la kenga na yeahile ɔ bo.

Belemgbunli ne ɔ nli dele dede ne na ɔrale ɛleka mɔɔ bɛlɛto ɛkponle ne la. Ɔzele belemgbunli ne kɛ: ‘Mmamaa ɛ rɛle bɔ. Nrenya bie wɔ wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ye anu mɔɔ ze nyamenle nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ a. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛ nlenya Nɛbukadenɛza di ebia la ɔyɛle ye ye nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma kpanyinli. Bɛfɛlɛ ye Daneɛle. Maa bɛhɔvɛlɛ ye, na ɔkɛha mɔɔ ɔkile la amuala ɔkɛhile wɔ.’

Yemɔti bɛhɔvale Daneɛle bɛrale ɛkɛ ne ala. Mɔɔ ɔkpole kɛ ɔkɛlie ahyɛlɛdeɛ biala ɔwiele la, Daneɛle hanle deɛ mɔɔ ɔti mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la Gyihova yele Bɛlehyaza ɔ nlenya Nɛbukadenɛza vile ebia ne azo la. Daneɛle hanle kɛ: ‘Ɔmemanle ɔ nwo zo. Na Gyihova hwenle ɔ nzo.’

Daneɛle akee zele Bɛlehyaza kɛ: ‘Na wɔmɔ, ɛze mɔɔ dole ye la amuala, noko ɛmemaa ɛ nwo zo kɛ Nɛbukadenɛza ala la. Wɔva ahɔpo ne nee ahyɛnze ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu la wɔra na wɔnlo bɛ nloa. Wɔye nyamenle mɔɔ bɛva baka nee bolɛ a bɛyɛ la ayɛlɛ, na wɔanli yɛ Bɔvolɛ Kpole ne eni. Yemɔti a Nyamenle ɛzoa ɛsalɛ ne yemaa yerahɛlɛ ngɛlɛlera ɛhye mɔ la.’ Daneɛle hanle kɛ: ‘Debie mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle la a le: MINI, MINI, TIKƐLE U PASEN.’

‘MINI abo kile kɛ Nyamenle ɛbu wɔ belemgbunlililɛ mekɛ yezɔ ɔ nloa na yeva yera awieleɛ. TIKƐLE kile kɛ bɛzuzu wɔ wɔ tone nu bɛnwu kɛ ɛndo ɛhwee. U PASEN kile kɛ bɛva wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne bɛmaa Midiama nee Pɛhyeama.’

Mɔɔ Daneɛle anloa wɔ zo bɔbɔ ɔlɛka edwɛkɛ ne la, ɛnee Midiama nee Pɛhyeama ɛbɔ Babelɔn anwo zo ɛhololɛ bo. Bɛvale suakpole ne na bɛhunle Bɛlehyaza. Ngɛlɛlera ne mɔɔ wɔ bane ne anwo la rale nu nɔe ne ala! Noko duzu a bado Yizilayɛma ne a? Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala yɛbanwu ye, noko maa yɛlumua yɛnlea mɔɔ dole Daneɛle la.Daneɛle 5:1-31. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

OO, OO! Ɔle kɛ asɛɛ edwɛkɛ kpole bie ɛdo Daneɛle la. Noko awenade ne mɔ ɛnyɛ ye ɛhwee! Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti yera ye zɔ la ɔ? Nwane a vale Daneɛle dole ɛke wɔ awenade ɛhye mɔ amuala anu a? Maa yɛnlea.

Nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Dalayɛse la a kɛkala le Babelɔn belemgbunli a. Ɛnee ɔkulo Daneɛle edwɛkɛ kpole kpalɛ ɔluakɛ Daneɛle le nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ na ɔ ti akunlu le kɛnlɛma. Dalayɛse yele Daneɛle kɛ amɛnladoma kpanyinli wɔ ye belemgbunlililɛ ne anu. Ɛhye manle mrenya gyɛne mɔɔ wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anu la vale Daneɛle ati ɛkpɔlɛ, ɔti mɔɔ bɛyɛle la ɛne.

Bɛhɔle Dalayɛse ɛkɛ na bɛzele ye kɛ: ‘Nana, yɛlie yɛdo nu kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛdi mɛla kɛ awie biala mmayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ maa nyamenle biala toonwo kenle 30 kɛ ɛ ngomekye ala, nana. Awie biala mɔɔ anli zolɛ la ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfuandi ye bɛto awenade ne mɔ tunli ne anu.’ Ɛnee Dalayɛse ɛnze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti menli ɛhye mɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔdi mɛla ɛhye la. Noko ɔliele adwenle ne ɔdole nu, na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔwulale ɔ bo. Kɛkala bɛngola bɛngakyi mɛla ne.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Daneɛle dele kɛ bɛli mɛla ne la, ɔhɔle sua nu ɔhɔzɛlɛle, kɛmɔ dahuu ɛnee ɔyɛ la. Ɛnee mrenya ne mɔ mɔɔ vale Daneɛle ati ɛkpɔlɛ la ze ye kɛ ɔnrɛgyakyi nzɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛ yeamaa Gyihova la ɛlɛ. Bɛ nye liele, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɔle kɛ asɛɛ bɛ kpɔkɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ kɛ bɛye Daneɛle ɛkɛ ne la ɛlɛyɛ boɛ.

Mɔɔ Belemgbunli Dalayɛse nwunle deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɛnee mrenya ɛhye mɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔdi mɛla ne la, ɔgyegyele ye. Noko ɛnee ɔnrɛhola mɛla ne kakyi, yemɔti ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔmaa bɛkɔfa Daneɛle na bɛfuandi ye bɛto awenade tunli ne anu. Noko belemgbunli ne hanle hilele Daneɛle kɛ: ‘Meze kɛ wɔ Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ ɛsonle ye la, balie wɔ.’ Ɔgyegyele Dalayɛse kpalɛ na nɔe ne yeangola da. Aleɛ hyenle la ɔhanle ɔ nwo ɔhɔle awenade tunli ne anwo. Kɛ ɛnwu ye kɛ ɔgyi ɛkɛ ɛ. Ɔdeanle nuhua kɛ: ‘Tease Nyamenle ne sonvolɛ Daneɛle! Asoo wɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛsonle ye dahuu la ɛhola ɛlie wɔ ɛvi awenade ne mɔ asa anu ɔ?’

Daneɛle buale kɛ: ‘Me Nyamenle ne zoanle ye anwumabɔvolɛ manle ɔratotole awenade ne mɔ anloa anu, yemɔti bɛanva bɛ nloa bɛanga me.’

Belemgbunli ne nyianle ahomeka. Ɔzile ɔ gyakɛ aze kɛ bɛye Daneɛle bɛvi awenade tunli ne anu. Akee ɔmanle bɛdole mrenya ne mɔ mɔɔ kpɔle Daneɛle la bɛguale awenade tunli ne anu. Bɛandwu aze wɔ tunli ne anu bɔbɔ, yɛɛ awenade ne mɔ sosɔle bɛ anwuma tetele bɛ azinli lile a.

Akee Belemgbunli Dalayɛse hɛlɛle hɔmanle menli mɔɔ wɔ ye belemgbunlililɛ ne anu la amuala kɛ: ‘Meli mɛla kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala di Daneɛle Nyamenle ne eni. Ɔyɛ nwanwane gyima mgbole. Yelie Daneɛle yevi awenade ne mɔ asa nu.’Daneɛle 6:1-28. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MIDIAMA nee Pɛhyeama honle vale Babelɔn la ye ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ nwiɔ ɛ. Na nea mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zo kɛkala la! Ɛhɛe, Yizilayɛma ne ɛlɛfi Babelɔn. Kɛ bɛzile bɛnyianle bɛ ti ɛ? Nwane a manle bɛ adenle kɛ bɛhɔ a?

Saelɛse, Pɛhyea belemgbunli ne, a manle bɛ adenle a. Mekɛ tendenle kolaa na bɛawo Saelɛse la, Gyihova manle ye ngapezonli Ayezaya hɛlɛle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ dole ɛkɛ ne kɛ: ‘Ɛbayɛ mɔɔ mekpondɛ kɛ ɛyɛ la pɛpɛɛpɛ. Bɛbabukebuke nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ bɛagua nwolɛ amaa wɔaho wɔava sua kpole ne.’ Na Saelɛse lile bɛ nyunlu manle bɛhonle bɛvale Babelɔn. Midiama nee Pɛhyeama ne vale nlenkɛ mɔɔ bɛbukebuke bɛgua nwo la anu nɔɔzo a hɔle sua kpole ne azo a.

Noko Gyihova ngapezonli Ayezaya eza hanle kɛ Saelɛse bazi ɔ gyakɛ aze yeamaa bakyekye Gyɛlusalɛm nee ye ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne bieko. Asoo Saelɛse yɛle ɛhye? Ɛhɛe, ɔyɛle zɔ. Mɔɔ Saelɛse zele Yizilayɛma ne la ɛne: ‘Bɛhɔ Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛhɔzi Gyihova, bɛ Nyamenle ne, ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne.’ Na ɛhye a Yizilayɛma agyakɛ wɔ zo ɛlɛkɔ ahɔyɛ a.

Noko tɛ Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ Babelɔn la amuala a bahola adu adenle tendenle ne azia ahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm a. Ɔle adenle tendenle kpalɛ mɔɔ bayɛ mayɛlɛ 500 (kilomita 800) na ɛnee bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo ɛnyinyi somaa na bɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛtu adenle tendenle a. Na ɛnee bie mɔ noko lɛ adwenle gyɛne mɔɔ ɔti bɛnrɛhɔ a. Na Saelɛse hanle hilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnrɛhɔ la kɛ: ‘Bɛmaa menli mɔɔ sia ahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ahɔkyekye ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne la dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke yɛɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne.’

Yemɔti, bɛmanle Yizilayɛma ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo. Saelɛse eza yele ahyɛnze nee ahɔpo ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu mɔɔ Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza yeyele hɔle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔzɛkyele Gyɛlusalɛm la amuala ɔmanle bɛ. Ɛnee menli ne lɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛsoa bɛahɔ a.

Mɔɔ ɛnee bɛdu adenle toonwo kɛyɛ siane nna la, Yizilayɛma ne radwule Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ mekɛ nloa. Bɛzɛkyele sua kpole ne la ɛnee ye ɛvolɛ 70 pɛpɛɛpɛ ɛ, na azɛlɛ ne lale mgbane mɔɔ ɛnee awie biala ɛnde zo a. Ɔwɔ nuhua kɛ Yizilayɛma ne ɛzia ɛra bɛ maanle nu ɛdeɛ, noko, ɛnee bɛbayia mekɛ ɛsesebɛ, kɛmɔ yɛbazukoa wɔ mɔɔ doa ye la anu la.Ayezaya 44:28; 45:1-⁠4; Ɛzela 1:1-11. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MENLI apenle dɔɔnwo dule adenle tendenle ne vile Babelɔn hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm. Noko bɛhɔdwule la, ɛnee Gyɛlusalɛm ɛbɔ bɔkɔɔ. Ɛnee awie biala ɛnde ɛkɛ. Na ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛma ne yɛ debie biala fofolɛ.

Ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛlumua bɛyɛle la anu ko a le afɔle mokyea ne. Ɛhye le ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbahola bɛava nane anzɛɛ ninyɛne gyɛne bɛabɔ afɔle bɛamaa Gyihova a. Mekɛ ekyi anzi, Yizilayɛma ne bɔle ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne ɛzilɛ bo. Noko ɛnee agbɔvolɛ mɔɔ dede azɛlɛ mɔɔ bikye bɛ la azo la ɛmkpondɛ kɛ Yizilayɛma ne si ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne. Ɔti bɛbɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛnwulonwunla bɛ bɛamaa bɛagyakyi. Awieleɛ kolaa ne, agbɔvolɛ ɛhye mɔ manle Pɛhyea belemgbunli fofolɛ ne lile mɛla duale sua ne ɛzilɛ.

Mekɛ hɔle bie. Na ɛnee akee Yizilayɛma ne vile Babelɔn ziale rale la yenyia ɛvolɛ 17. Gyihova zoanle ye ngapezoma Hagae yɛɛ Zɛkalaya kɛ bɛraze menli ne kɛ bɛbɔ sua ne ɛzilɛ bo bieko. Menli ne vale bɛ nwo dole Nyamenle moalɛ zo, na bɛdiele ngapezoma ne. Bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛsi sua ne, ɔnvane nwolɛ kɛ ɛnee mɛla kile kɛ bɛmmasi la.

Yemɔti Pɛhyea amɛnlado Tatenae rale rabizale Yizilayɛma ne adenle mɔɔ bɛlɛ kɛ bɛsi ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne la. Yizilayɛma ne zele ye kɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Babelɔn la Belemgbunli Saelɛse zele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛhɔ Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛhɔzi Gyihova, bɛ Nyamenle ne, ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne.’

Tatenae manle bɛvale kɛlata bɛhɔle Babelɔn bɛhɔbizale saa Saelɛse, mɔɔ ɛnee ɛwu la, amgba hanle zɔ a. Yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ kɛlata vi Pɛhyea belemgbunli fofolɛ ne ɛkɛ ne rale a. Ɔhanle kɛ amgba Saelɛse hanle zɔ. Yemɔti belemgbunli ne hɛlɛle kɛ: ‘Bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ne adenle bɛmaa bɛzi bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne. Na mese wɔ kɛ ɛboa bɛ.’ Wɔ ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ nna anu bɛwiele ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne si, na Yizilayɛma ne anye liele kpole.

Ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo pɛle nu. Bɛwiele ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne si la ye ɛvolɛ asɛɛ 48 ɛne. Na ɛnee menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la le ehyiavolɛma, na ɛnee suakpole ne azo yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne ɛnle kɛnlɛma fee zɛ. Wɔ Babelɔn ɛkɛ ne, Yizilayɛnli Ɛzela ranwunle ɛhyianlɛ mɔɔ ɔhyia kɛ bɛsiezie Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne la. Ɔti ɛze mɔɔ ɔyɛle a?

Ɛzela hɔnwunle Pɛhyea belemgbunli, Atazɛzɛse, na belemgbunli atikunlukɛnlɛma ɛhye manle Ɛzela ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo manle ɔvale ɔziale ɔhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɛzela zɛlɛle Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ Babelɔn la kɛ bɛboa ye bɛmaa ɔva ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ ɔhɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Menli kɛyɛ 6,000 a liele dole nuhua kɛ bɛkɛhɔ a. Ɛnee bɛlɛ dwɛtɛ fufule nee nvutuke yɛɛ ninyɛne gyɛne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la dɔɔnwo bɛsoa bɛkɔ.

Ɛzela arɛle bɔle, ɔluakɛ ɛnee nindavoma dɔɔnwo wɔ adenle nu. Ɛnee menli ɛhye mɔ bahola aza bɛ alie bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule ne nee bɛ nvutuke ne mɔ, na bɛahu bɛ. Yemɔti Ɛzela vɛlɛle menli ne na ɔyiale bɛ, kɛmɔ yɛnwu ye wɔ nvoninli ye anu la. Akee bɛzɛlɛle Gyihova kɛ ɔbɔ bɛ nwo bane wɔ bɛ adenle tendendenlenle ne mɔɔ bɛtu bɛazia bɛahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anu.

Gyihova bɔle bɛ nwo bane. Na bɛvale bɛ nwo kɔlɔɔnwo bɛhɔdwule Gyɛlusalɛm, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛdu adenle toonwo siane nna la. Asoo ɛhye ɛngile kɛ Gyihova kola bɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto ɔ nwo zo bɛkpondɛ moalɛ la anwo bane ɔ?Ɛzela tile 2 kɔdwu 8. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MAA yɛzia yɛ nzi yɛhɔ ɛvolɛ ekyi mɔɔ zenle kolaa na Ɛzela ahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la. Ɛnee Mɔdekae nee Ɛseta a le Yizilayɛma titile mɔɔ wɔ Pɛhyea belemgbunlililɛ ne anu a. Ɛnee Ɛseta le belemgbunli raalɛ, yɛɛ saa belemgbunli ne mɔɔ ɛnee di ebia la ɛnle ɛkɛ a, ɔ ze adiema nrenya ara Mɔdekae a wɔ ɛkɛ a. Maa yɛnlea kɛ ɛhye zile rale la.

Ɛseta awovolɛ wule mekɛ mɔɔ ɔle ekyi la, ɔti Mɔdekae a tetele ye a. Ɛnee Pɛhyea belemgbunli, Zɛzɛse (Ahazelɔse), lɛ belemgbunli sua wɔ suakpole Susa azo, na ɛnee Mɔdekae le ye sonvolɛma ne anu ko. Kenle ko, Vahyetae, belemgbunli ne aye ne, dule belemgbunli ne anloa dole, ɔti belemgbunli ne yele yelɛ fofolɛ yɛle ye belemgbunli raalɛ. Ɛze raalɛ mɔɔ ɔyele ye la ɔ? Ɛhɛe, bɛlɛra kakula kɛnlɛma Ɛseta ɔ. Asoo ɛnwu nrenya ɛhye mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo mɔɔ menli ɛlɛkoto ye la ɔ? Heeman ɛne. Ɔle sonla kpole wɔ Pɛhyea. Heeman kpondɛ kɛ Mɔdekae, mɔɔ ɛnwu kɛ ɔde ɛkɛ ne la, noko koto ye. Noko Mɔdekae anyɛ zɔ ɛlɛ. Ɛnee ɔze ye kɛ ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ ɔkɛhoto sonla ɛtane zɛhae. Ɛhye manle Heeman vale ɛya kpole. Ɛhye ati mɔɔ ɔyɛle la ɛne.

Heeman hanle Yizilayɛma ne anwo adalɛ edwɛkɛ hilele belemgbunli ne. Ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Bɛnle menli mgbalɛ na bɛnli wɔ mɛla ɛdeɛ ne azo. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku bɛ.’ Ɛnee Zɛzɛse ɛnze kɛ ɔ ye Ɛseta le Yizilayɛnli. Yemɔti ɔdiele Heeman ane, na ɔmanle bɛyɛle mɛla bɛhilele kenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku Yizilayɛma amuala a.

Mɔɔ Mɔdekae dele mɛla ne anwo bie la, ɔgyegyele ye kpole kpalɛ. Ɔdole Ɛseta nrɛlaleɛ kɛ: ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛka ɛkile belemgbunli ne, na ɛsɛlɛ ye ɛmaa ɔdie yɛ.’ Ɔtia Pɛhyeama mɛla kɛ awie kɛhɔnwu belemgbunli ne, kyesɛ bɛfɛlɛ ye. Noko Ɛseta hɔle mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛfɛlɛle ye. Belemgbunli ne kpogyale ye ezukoa nvutuke kpɔma ne zo hilele ye, mɔɔ ɛnee ɔkile kɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛku ye. Ɛseta dole ɛsalɛ vɛlɛle belemgbunli ne nee Heeman hɔle ɛkponledolɛ kpole bie abo. Wɔ ɛkponledolɛ ne abo belemgbunli ne bizale Ɛseta mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ kɛ ɔyɛ ɔmaa ye la. Ɛseta buale kɛ saa ɛhyema ɔ nee Heeman kɛra ye ɛkponledolɛ ne abo bieko a anrɛɛ ɔkɛha ɔkɛhile ye.

Wɔ ɛkponledolɛ zɔhane abo, Ɛseta hanle hilele belemgbunli ne kɛ: ‘Bɛku me nee me menli ne.’ Belemgbunli ne vale ɛya. Ɔbizale kɛ: ‘Ɛnee nwane a ɔdaye ɔyɛ debie zɛhae a?’

Ɛseta buale kɛ: ‘Nrenya ne, kpɔvolɛ ne, a le Heeman amumuyɛ ɛhye!’

Belemgbunli ne akee vale ɛya kpole. Ɔzile ɔ gyakɛ aze kɛ bɛhu Heeman. Amozii, belemgbunli ne yɛle Mɔdekae tumivolɛ mɔɔ ɔnle ɛkɛ a ɔdaye a ɔwɔ ɛkɛ a. Akee Mɔdekae nleanle manle bɛyɛle mɛla fofolɛ mɔɔ maa Yizilayɛma ne adenle bɛko bɛdie bɛ nwo wɔ kenle ne mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku bɛ la azo. Kɛmɔ ɛnee akee Mɔdekae ɛrayɛ sonla kpole zɛhae la ati, menli dɔɔnwo boale Yizilayɛma ne, na bɛnyianle bɛ ti wɔ bɛ agbɔvolɛ asa nu.Ɛseta Baebolo buluku ne. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA gyima mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zo wɔ ɛke la kɔsɔɔti. Yizilayɛma ne anye ɛbolo ɛlɛkyekye Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne. Mɔɔ Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza sɛkye Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ ɛvolɛ 152 mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la anu la, ɔhanle bane ne ɔguale aze na ɔyelale suakpole ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ. Yizilayɛma ne ankyekye bane ne bieko wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Babelɔn bɛrale ɛkɛ ne ala la.

Duzu nganeɛ a ɛnea a menli ne dele wɔ mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ bɛdɛnlanle suakpole ne azo mɔɔ ɛnee bane biala ɛnle nwolɛ la ɛ? Ɛnee bɛte nganeɛ kɛ bɛwɔ esiane kpole nu. Ɛnee bɛ agbɔvolɛ bahola araholo bɛ nwo zo mekɛ biala. Noko kɛkala nrenya Nihɛmaya ɛhye ɛlɛboa menli ne amaa bɛakyekye bane ne bieko. Asoo ɛze Nihɛmaya sonla holɛ?

Nihɛmaya le Yizilayɛnli mɔɔ vi Susa, ɛleka mɔɔ ɛnee Mɔdekae nee Ɛseta de la. Nihɛmaya yɛle gyima wɔ belemgbunli ne sua nu, ɔti ɛnee ɔbayɛ kɛ ɔ nee Mɔdekae nee Belemgbunli raalɛ Ɛseta lɛ agɔnwolɛvalɛ kpalɛ. Noko Baebolo ne ɛnga kɛ Nihɛmaya yɛle gyima manle Ɛseta ahu, Belemgbunli Zɛzɛse (Ahazelɔse). Emomu ɔyɛle gyima ɔmanle belemgbunli ne mɔɔ doale ye, mɔɔ yemɔ a le Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse la.

Kakye kɛ Atazɛzɛse a le belemgbunli atiakunlukɛnlɛma ne mɔɔ vale ezukoa mɔɔ Ɛzela vale rale Gyɛlusalɛm rayɛle Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne la amuala manle ye a. Noko Ɛzela ankyekye suakpole ne bane ne mɔɔ hanle guale aze la. Maa yɛnlea kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ Nihɛmaya a rayɛle gyima ɛhye la.

Atazɛzɛse vale ezukoa ne manle Ɛzela kɛ ɔhɔyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne boɛ la ye ɛvolɛ 13 ɛne. Nihɛmaya a kɛkala le Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse sonvolɛ kpanyinli mɔɔ nea nza zo a. Ɛhye kile kɛ ɛnee yemɔ a ɔsu belemgbunli ne nza a, na ɔnea kɛ awie biala ɛnrɛva ayile ɛtane biala ɛnrɛgua belemgbunli ne nza nu na ɔnrɛhu ye. Ɛnee ɔle gyima mɔɔ sonle bolɛ kpalɛ.

Kenle ko Nihɛmaya adiema nrenya mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Haneenae la nee mrenya bie vi Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo rakpɔlale Nihɛmaya. Bɛhanle ngyegyelɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ne wɔ nu, nee Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔɔ bɛtɛyɛle la anwo edwɛkɛ bɛhilele ye. Ɛhye manle Nihɛmaya lile nyane dɔɔnwo, na ɔzɛlɛle Gyihova wɔ nwolɛ.

Kenle ko, belemgbunli ne nwunle ye kɛ Nihɛmaya ɛlɛdi nyane, ɔti ɔbizale kɛ: ‘Duzu ati yɛɛ ɛ nyunlu ɛyɛ alɔbɔlɛ alɔbɔlɛ zɛhae a?’ Nihɛmaya buale ye kɛ ɔ nyunlu ɛyɛ alɔbɔlɛ ɔluakɛ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛdɔ mgbane na ye bane ne mɔ ɛha ɛgua aze la ati ɔ. Belemgbunli ne bizale kɛ: ‘Duzu a menyɛ memaa wɔ a?’

Nihɛmaya hanle kɛ: ‘Maa mengɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, amaa meahɔkyekye bane ne.’ Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse ati ɛnyɛ se. Ɔhanle kɛ Nihɛmaya kola kɔ, na ɔboale ye ɔmanle ɔnyianle mbaka mɔɔ ɔbava yeayɛ bane ne la bie. Yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ Nihɛmaya hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm a, na ɔhanle kpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yebɔ la ɔhilele menli ne. Bɛliele kpɔkɛ ne bɛdole nuhua, na bɛhanle kɛ: ‘Bɛmaa yɛdwazo yɛyɛ bane ne.’ Mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ne agbɔvolɛ ne mɔ nwunle kɛ bane ne ɛlɛkɔ anwuma la, bɛhanle kɛ: ‘Yɛbadoa bɛ yɛahɔhu bɛ, na yɛazɛkye gyima ne.’ Noko Nihɛmaya dele ɛhye anwo bie, yemɔti ɔmanle gyimayɛvoma ne mɔ dadeɛ nee atwɛ. Na ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Bɛmmasulo yɛ agbɔvolɛ ne mɔ. Bɛho bɛmaa bɛ mediema, bɛ mra, bɛ ye mɔ, nee bɛ azua nu.’

Ɛnee menli ne akɛnra yɛ se kpalɛ. Bɛhɔle zo bɛzinzale nɔɔzo nee ewiazo, na bɛkyekyele bane ne. Yemɔti wɔ kenle 52 anu ala yɛɛ bɛwiele bane ne a. Akee menli ne nwunle ye kɛ bɛlɛ anwobanebɔlɛ wɔ suakpole ne azo. Nihɛmaya nee Ɛzela hilehilele menli ne Nyamenle mɛla ne, na menli ne anye liele.

Noko ɛnee ninyɛne ɛnle kɛ mɔɔ bɛde kolaa na bɛahye Yizilayɛma ne nuokɛ bɛahɔ Babelɔn la. Pɛhyea belemgbunli ne a ɛnee di menli ne anwo zo a, na ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle ye. Noko ɛnee Gyihova ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbazoa belemgbunli fofolɛ bie, na belemgbunli fofolɛ ɛhye bava anzondwolɛ arɛlɛ menli ne. Belemgbunli ɛhye a le nwane? Kɛ ɔbazi yeava anzondwolɛ yeara azɛlɛ ye azo ɛ? Ɛvolɛ 450 pɛle nu na bɛanwu ninyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ fane ɛhye anwo la. Akee bɛwole kakula bie mɔɔ ɔ nwo hyia kpole kpalɛ a. Noko yemɔ le edwɛkɛ fofolɛ.Nihɛmaya tile 1 kɔdwu 6. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia
